$comment: Reference tenant configuration for SkyDeals Europe, the first ABOS White-Label customer. This file is DATA, not code: onboarding another aviation company means adding a sibling file here (and a Tenant/License record via tenantProvision), never editing a component. Values here are the presentation layer only — the authoritative license and capability grant lives in the License entity, enforced server-side by tenantCoreApi. Anything in this file is advisory to the UI and is never trusted for authorization.
$capabilities_note: expected_capabilities documents what the Professional plan is sold as, for the installer's feature-selection UI to preselect. It is NOT the grant — tenantCoreApi reads License.allowed_capabilities server-side and ignores this entirely.
